note: Each wallet material as a vanilla item: tagged with custom_data {ascensionlib:{material, batch?}} and a custom_model_data the server resource pack maps to art. Base items are inert and stack to 64. A tradable value of false keeps a material out of withdrawal (default true). An item with no batch is LOOT FORM (absorbed into the wallet when carried); an item with a batch is a VOUCHER (tradable, redeemed with /ascend wallet deposit). Each item has a rarity (see "rarities"): its tooltip opens with a coloured rarity line, and the lore line after it says what kind of item it is.

dex.name: AscensionDex
lore: Right-click to review your party
and pick a Pokemon to inspect.

resonance_dust.name: Resonance Dust
lore: Raw resonance, spent on upgrades,
refining and perfecting.

facet.name: Facet
lore: A cut crystal that sharpens an affix.
Spent on reforging and overreaching.

ascension_core.name: Ascension Core
lore: The heart of a promotion.
Earned in the Tower.

apex_shard.name: Apex Shard
lore: A crown of crystal won from raid bosses.
Needed for the highest promotions.

unique_fragment.name: Unique Fragment
lore: Collect enough to assemble
a Unique Catalyst.

unique_catalyst.name: Unique Catalyst
lore: Installs or replaces a Unique power.

scouter.name: Scouter
lore: Reveals one enemy's rating.

ascension_sigil.name: Ascension Sigil
lore: Gives a Pokemon with no profile
a rolled rarity.

tower_mark.name: Tower Mark
lore: Proof of a Tower clear.
Bound to you; it cannot be traded.

rank_respec.name: Hourglass of Undoing
lore: Resets one Pokemon's ranks to I and
returns its upgrade credits to spend again.
Materials are not refunded. Never works
on an Overreached Pokemon.

unique_respec.name: Unbinding Prism
lore: Swaps a Pokemon's Unique for another,
with no Catalyst and no Tower Mark.

spooky_essence.name: Spooky Essence
lore: Halloween 2026. Spent with /ascend haunt
to give a Pokemon a random Haunting.
Earned from the World Boss; trade it
freely. It works after the event ends.
